name: Jarvis Meme
look: White caption space above a close-up of Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark inside the Iron Man helmet, staring straight ahead with a slight smirk. His goateed face is surrounded by glowing blue holographic readouts on black.
use: The caption is a command to Jarvis, Tony Stark's AI assistant, usually "Jarvis," followed by an absurd or petty request, treated like activating a high-tech protocol.
slots: the command to Jarvis (white space above)
examples: Jarvis, reheat the pizza without making the crust soggy
Jarvis, pretend to type so my boss thinks I'm busy

robert downey jr face close up in the iron man suit display
iron man giving orders to his ai assistant

asking the ai butler to do something ridiculous
origin: Robert Downey Jr. as Tony Stark inside his Iron Man helmet in the Marvel films, where he gives orders to his AI assistant Jarvis.
